description: Append a freeform note to a persisted session's audit trail - an additive local write, no provider calls. Requires sessions.persist. Returns a text-wrapped JSON envelope { session } (the updated record), or { error } when persistence is off or the id is unknown.

note.description: Freeform text appended to the record's audit trail.

sessionId.description: Id of the persisted session record to annotate.

name: session-annotate
